What you buy

Each Moving Cyanotypes pack is a digital product: high-resolution A3 print files (JPG), a handwritten poem note (A4, JPG), a signed certificate of authenticity (PDF) and a personal print licence (PDF), delivered as a zip file. No physical item is shipped.

Price and payment

Prices are in euro and are the final price you pay. Payment is handled by Stripe. I never see or store your card details.

Delivery

Right after payment you are taken to a download page. You also receive a receipt by email from Stripe. If the download does not work, email me and I will send the files.

Right of withdrawal

As a consumer in the EU you normally have 14 days to withdraw from an online purchase. For digital content delivered immediately, this right ends once the download is made available, because at checkout you ask for immediate delivery and accept that you lose the right of withdrawal (art. 59, letter o, Italian Consumer Code). If a file is damaged or not as described, email me and I will replace it or refund you.

Licence

The files are for personal use only: you may print them for yourself, at home or through a print shop. You may not share, resell, upload or use them commercially. Copyright stays with Mattia Giannattasio, and the words of the poems with Matteo Martignoni. The full licence is included in each pack.

Complaints and law

For any problem write to the email above and I will answer within a few days. These terms follow Italian law. EU consumers can also use the EU online dispute resolution platform at ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.
